metadata.title: Relationship Flow Tarot Prompt | tarot-spark
metadata.description: Draw a reflective relationship-flow tarot spread and copy four detailed AI prompts for patterns, perspectives, actions, and emotions.

heading: See the relationship pattern without pretending to know the other person’s mind.
intro: Use a six-card spread to separate what you observe, what you infer, and what you can influence. Then choose one of four detailed prompts for the kind of reflection you need next.
benefitsHeading: Built for a more useful AI conversation

benefits.title: One connected pattern
benefits.body: The prompt asks the AI to connect all six positions instead of repeating isolated card definitions.

benefits.title: Four complete lenses
benefits.body: Explore the main reading, a challenging alternative, a practical action plan, or an emotion check-in.

benefits.title: Agency before prediction
benefits.body: The reading separates your choices from uncertain outcomes and another person’s private thoughts.

steps.title: 1. Add only the context you need
steps.body: Describe the dynamic without names, contact details, birth dates, or workplace secrets. You can also leave the field empty.

steps.title: 2. Draw the deep six-card spread
steps.body: The positions cover the current situation, your perspective, external dynamics, hidden tension, agency, and a grounded next step.

steps.title: 3. Copy the prompt that fits
steps.body: Paste the selected prompt into your preferred AI writing tool, then keep what is useful and question what is not.

exampleHeading: The Lovers + The Star can hold connection and recovery at the same time.
exampleBody: A grounded interpretation might ask whether mutual choice is visible in behavior, where hope needs patience, and which boundary would protect both honesty and self-respect. It would not claim proof of hidden feelings or guarantee an outcome.

faqs.question: Can this tell me exactly what another person feels?
faqs.answer: No. Tarot symbols can support reflection, but they cannot verify another person’s hidden feelings, motives, or future actions.

faqs.question: Where does my situation text go?
faqs.answer: Optional context stays in your browser. It is excluded from reading URLs and analytics, and leaves the site only if you choose to copy or share it elsewhere.

faqs.question: Which prompt should I start with?
faqs.answer: Start with Main reading for the full pattern. Use Other perspective when you want to challenge assumptions, Action plan for practical options, or Emotion check-in to separate feelings, evidence, needs, and boundaries.

ctaHeading: Ready to map the relationship flow?
ctaBody: The generator will open with the relationship-centered six-card setup. You can change every choice before drawing.
privacyNote: No account required. Keep names and identifying details out of optional context.
disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. Not medical, legal, financial, investment, or mental-health advice.
